current_goal: Reconstruct or rebuild the MD-2S background profiles and close the numerical MDS-05 normalization without bypassing boundary, frame or provenance gates.

verified_results.statement: For the minimal HZT-M0-S6 Einstein-Hilbert sector, the bulk four-dimensional normalization is M4_bulk_squared = V_W / kappa6_squared with V_W equal to the warped internal two-volume.
The archived value V_W = 0.5318111250097 cannot yet determine kappa4 because its angle-factor, dimensional normalization and four-dimensional frame convention are unresolved.
For a scale-free self-adjoint internal eigenproblem, mode masses have the conditional form m_n = Xi_n / R_chi; the numerical Xi_n and physical mode identity remain open.
The flat two-dimensional Gaussian cumulative overlap q = 1 - exp(-gamma R_chi_squared) is exact under its declared measure, profile and cutoff assumptions; the warped MD-2S overlap remains open.

open_blockers.statement: No provenance-complete executable MD-2S solver package with profiles, residuals, one-sided boundary data and hashes is currently recovered.
The cap system cannot be closed from a single effective tension value; both metric junction components and scalar, gauge, flux and pole conditions are required.
The numerical warped volume requires reproduced A(r), L(r), the angular period or deficit convention, a fixed four-dimensional frame and convergence-tested integration.

active_assumptions: The controlled reduction branch is HZT-M0-S6 with one physical time and a positive-definite internal two-space.
The current MDS-05 derivation uses the canonical minimal bulk Einstein-Hilbert term and does not include nonminimal curvature couplings or localized Einstein-Hilbert terms unless explicitly added.
All numerical promotion requires the MD-2S profile, boundary, frame, unit and provenance contracts to be closed first.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer physical identification from technical execution.
Do not infer ghost freedom from a positive M4_squared or numerical stability.
Do not infer a numerical kappa4 from the historical V_W value while its normalization is ambiguous.
Do not infer a released 6D prediction from MD-2N through MD-2Q diagnostic dry runs.
Do not change K1-D or K1-E without the governed release chain.
next_exact_action: Freeze the remaining MD-2S model and boundary conventions, then derive and implement the reproducible radial background equations needed to export A(r), L(r), one-sided cap data, residuals and the unambiguous warped volume.
